## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### Added
- Carts are saved for 30 days for logged-out users (#211)
- Dark mode for the account page (#217)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Orders endpoint now returns prices in cents (#214)

### Fixed
- Mobile checkout total now applies the discount code (#213)
- Search box keeps focus after the first letter is typed (#215)

### Security
- Password reset links now expire (#219)

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### Added
- Download invoices as PDF (#301)
- Invite teammates by email (#304)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Removed the deprecated `/v1/customers` endpoint (#305)
- Search results load twice as fast on large catalogues (#308)

### Fixed
- Invoice VAT was rounded the wrong way for totals ending in .5 (#303)
- Date picker showed the wrong month in Safari (#307)

### Security
- Uploaded files could be read by other accounts (#309)

## [0.9.2] - 2026-12-01

### Added
- New `tool doctor` command to check your setup (#42)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Config file renamed from `.toolrc` to `tool.toml` (#41)

### Fixed
- `--quiet` flag no longer prints warnings (#40)
- Crash when using Windows paths that contain spaces (#45)

### Security
- Patch remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-4411) by upgrading the YAML parser (#44)

## [3.2.0] - 2026-12-08

### Added
- Offline maps for saved trips (#515)
- Share a trip with a link that expires (#519)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Trips endpoint paginates by default, 50 items per page (#518)

### Fixed
- Edits made offline were lost after logging in (#517)
- Map pins overlapped on small screens (#521)

### Removed
- Legacy trip importer (#524)

### Security
- Shared links exposed the owner's email address (#522)

## [1.11.0] - 2027-01-05

### Added
- Spell check for 14 languages in the editor (#87)
- Export documents as Markdown (#91)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Internet Explorer 11 is no longer supported (#93)

### Fixed
- Undo no longer skips every second change in the editor (#89)
- Tables pasted from Excel keep their borders (#94)

### Security
- Session tokens are no longer written to the browser console (#90)

## [4.0.1] - 2027-01-19

### Added
- Pause a subscription for up to 3 months (#706)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Annual plans now renew on the purchase date instead of the 1st of the month (#702)

### Fixed
- Receipts showing the wrong currency symbol (#703)
- CSV exports cutting off rows after 10,000 (#707)

### Security
- Webhook signatures are now verified, so forged webhooks are rejected (#705)
